use default

class NODE(name: string, weight: double, own_coverage: double?) is
    children: LIST[NODE]

    init(..) is
        children = LIST()
    si

    coverage: double =>
        if let given = own_coverage then
            given
        elif children.count == 0 then
            0.0D
        else
            let weighted = children
                |> map(child => child.weight * child.coverage)
                |> reduce(0.0D, (a, b) => a + b)
            let total = children
                |> map(child => child.weight)
                |> reduce(0.0D, (a, b) => a + b)

            weighted / total
        fi

    rows(depth: int) -> Pipe[string] is
        let label = "{string(' ', depth * 4)}{name}"
        let shown_weight = if weight =~ 1.0D then "" else "{weight}" fi
        let shown_coverage =
            if let given = own_coverage then "{given}" else "" fi

        let columns = "{label,-32}|{shown_weight,-8}|{shown_coverage,-10}|"

        yield "{columns}{coverage,8:F4}"

        for child in children do
            yield in child.rows(depth + 1)
        od
    si
si
